## Author checklist

- [ ] One Linear issue, one executor, one branch, one PR.
- [ ] PR does not target `main` through a direct push.
- [ ] No shared personal tokens, Telegram sessions, production secrets, or production data.
- [ ] Tests and CI results are reported truthfully.
- [ ] No unresolved high-risk review findings.
- [ ] Dependencies and stacked-PR order are explicit.
- [ ] Merge is left to the repository owner or an explicitly authorized merge owner.
